name: diva-sdk
description: Build and manage AI agents on the Diva platform with the Diva SDK (Python & TypeScript) — ready-made skills, project scaffolds, and the Diva platform MCP wired in.

diva_api_key.description: Your Diva API key (sk-diva-…). Used as the bearer token for the Diva platform MCP and by the SDK. Get it from your Diva workspace → Developers → SDK.
